title: DataProvenance
description: Where a piece of data came from and how fresh it is. Live, cached, historical, and fixture data must be visibly and permanently distinguished in every payload (architecture.md §4.2).

data_mode.description: 'unavailable' (Checkpoint Phase 4 C.0 correction pass) is a purely additive new enum value: no data or estimate exists at all, distinct from 'estimated' (a computed fallback genuinely exists). Every pre-existing document using only the original five values remains valid unchanged.
